verdicts.reason: A pulls the bottle away from its cream circle, so the circle sits as an empty blob next to a floating bottle. Its pill buttons became sharp-cornered rectangles, which loses a brand shape, and the NEW badge is nearly as large as the Try It CTA, so the badge competes with the call to action. B keeps the bottle on its circle and keeps the pill buttons, but the bottle is small, jammed against the top-left edge and spills over the top of the circle. B's NEW and Try It sit right-aligned at different widths, which leaves a big dead area at the bottom left, and NEW is still oversized for a badge.
